text: Should we deploy release candidate rc-4 to production this Friday?

presuppositions.text: Release candidate rc-4 has been built and is available.
A Friday deployment window is an option under the current change policy.

resolution_criteria: Answer is complete and closed when a single value from {yes,no,indeterminate} is chosen AND a warrant cites the rc-4 test pass rate, open Sev-1 count, and rollback readiness against the documented go/no-go thresholds.
decision_relevance: Directly determines whether the team executes the Friday production deploy or holds; it is the go/no-go decision gate for this release.

sub_questions.text: Does rc-4 pass the full regression and smoke suite above the release threshold?
How many open Sev-1 defects are attributable to rc-4?
Is a verified rollback path available within the deployment window?
